cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul && cat > /tmp/repro.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

static void out(const MD_CHAR* text, MD_SIZE size, void* userdata) {}
int main(int argc,char**argv){FILE*f=fopen(argv[1],"rb");if(!f){perror("fopen");return 2;}fseek(f,0,SEEK_END);long n=ftell(f);rewind(f);unsigned char*buf=malloc(n);if(n)fread(buf,1,n,f);fclose(f); if(n<8)return 0; unsigned pf=((unsigned*)buf)[0], rf=((unsigned*)buf)[1]; int r=md_html((char*)buf+8,n-8,out,NULL,pf,rf); free(buf); return r;}
EOF
